chunks: And Abu Ishaq narrated from al-Harith, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever hoards food, mercy is removed from him.

key_terms.الرَّحْمَةُ: mercy; divine compassion and blessing withdrawn because of the act
key_terms.الطَّعَامَ: food; the essential commodity being referred to
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.نُزِعَتْ: was removed; indicates deprivation or stripping away

ai.seo_question: What does Imam 'Ali عليه السلام say about hoarding food?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns withholding food in a way that strips a person of divine mercy. It presents such conduct as a serious moral failing tied to social harm and economic injustice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3964 - Abu Ishaq narrated from Al-Harith, from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib, who said:
"Whoever hoards food, mercy is removed from him."
